name: ask-nous
title_zh: 问生意别问计划，它直接翻客户关系图谱答你
tagline_zh: 不用记字段、不用拉报表，用大白话问「谁提过预算」「哪单碰了竞品」，它从 Nous 图谱里把答案捞给你。
tagline_en: Skip dashboards and field names. Ask in plain words who mentioned budget or which deals touch a competitor — it.
desc_en: Answers plain-language questions about the pipeline and accounts from the Nous graph — "who mentioned budget", "which deals touch a competitor", "accounts in negotiation that went quiet", "who replied this week". Use whenever the user asks a question about their book of business, contacts, deals, activity, or what the graph knows, rather than asking for a full plan or review.
why_zh: 它不生成计划也不写总结，只做一件事：把自然语言问题翻译成图谱查询。问得越具体，答得越准，不绕弯。
why_en: It skips planning and summaries entirely — just translates plain-language questions into graph queries. The sharper your ask.
limit_zh: 只认 Nous 图谱里已有的客户、联系人、交易和活动数据；问「该怎么办」这类要建议或计划的问题，它不会答。
limit_en: Only answers from data already in your Nous graph (accounts, contacts, deals, activity). Won't give advice or plans — for that, switch to another.
title_en: Ask your deal graph plain questions, get plain answers
